sloka: तानि निर्दह्यमानानि दूरतः प्रचकाशिरे।हिमवच्छिखराणीव दीप्तौषधिवनानि च ।। ६.७५.२४ ।।
transliteration: tāni nirdahyamānāni dūrataḥ pracakāśire।himavacchikharāṇīva dīptauṣadhivanāni ca ।। 6.75.24 ।।

translations.english: The lovely women sleeping in burnt mansion tops screamed loudly in desperation saying 'Alas! Oh Oh!' and removing their ornaments.
